description: Atlas-authored candidate associations for 14 new profiles and three additional HNF1B findings. Clinical descriptions are distinct from formal HPO disease annotations; frequency and diagnostic performance are not inferred.
scopeNotes: ORPHA:18 includes acquired dRTA; this profile uses hereditary dRTA descriptions only. Alkaline urine alone does not establish distal acidification failure.
ORPHA:213 includes ocular cystinosis; the renal profile is nephropathic cystinosis. ORPHA:223 also covers acquired vasopressin resistance; the profile is hereditary NDI.
Bartter, dRTA, Dent, FHHNC, PHA1 and NDI remain broad profiles without subtype inference. Hearing and ocular findings are subtype-dependent.

Low-molecular-weight proteinuria is distinct from existing generic proteinuria. Neither auto-selects the other. Broad metabolic acidosis and hyperchloraemic metabolic acidosis are distinct, but no added profile scores both.
Renal magnesium/phosphate/salt wasting requires documented renal loss; blood concentrations alone do not establish it. Correlated findings each count one and are not independent likelihood evidence.
Existing hyposthenuria, growth_delay, seizure, ataxia, hearing and family-history definitions are reused verbatim. No unknown state or numeric threshold inference is introduced.

HNF1B retains its seven earlier associations and gains hypomagnesaemia, renal magnesium wasting and renal cysts. It now uses the count model because the pinned candidate weights do not cover the extension.
